sub_question: SQ4: What can an AI agent do with the data to advise people with respiratory illness?
summary: The agent's value is turning raw monitor data + public AQI data products into anticipatory, condition-specific advice. Three real EPA data products form the backbone: NowCast AQI (current hour, adaptive averaging — real-time 'is now OK to go out?'), AQI Forecast (next-day, issued each afternoon — activity planning), and the AirNow API (integration feed). The agent layers personalization (condition, symptom log, meds), the SQ3 lag structure, and the SQ1 'Orange/100+' respiratory trigger on top.
key_insight: The agent is not a dashboard — it is an ANTICIPATORY, PERSONALIZED translation layer. Its distinctive capabilities: (1) fuse live device readings with NowCast (now) + Forecast (tomorrow) + lag3 particulate delay to WARN before symptoms, not after; (2) attribute cause per-pollutant (weight NO2/O3 for COPD, PM2.5 for asthma) and name the driving pollutant; (3) escalate on the respiratory-specific Orange band (AQI 100+), not the public 150+; (4) correlate the user's own symptom/rescue-inhaler log against exposure to learn personal trigger thresholds; (5) convert category → concrete action ('reschedule your run to this morning when O3 is lower', 'keep your reliever inhaler with you', 'run the purifier, close windows').

data_products_backbone.NowCast_AQI: current-hour AQI (O3+PM); adaptive averaging (shorter windows when air changes fast, e.g. wildfire) — powers real-time go/no-go
data_products_backbone.AQI_Forecast: next-day prediction issued each afternoon; ozone forecast targets the peak 8-h window; includes 'forecast discussion' of WHEN pollution peaks during the day — powers activity timing
data_products_backbone.AirNow_API: docs.airnowapi.org — programmatic current + forecast feed for integration

agent_capability_stack: Real-time alerting keyed to personal thresholds (not just national breakpoints)
Anticipatory warnings using next-day forecast + lag3 particulate delay
Activity-timing optimization (find the low-pollution window in the day)
Symptom-exposure correlation to personalize trigger levels over time
Actionable, plain-language guidance mapped from AQI category
Medication/action reminders (reliever inhaler, purifier, mask, close windows)
Escalation logic: nudge → strong caution → advise contacting clinician on sustained high exposure + worsening symptoms
detail.addresses_emergent: Partly answers q428d8806 (forecasting): AirNow API + AQI Forecast is the feed; deeper forecasting (pollen, ML symptom-risk) still open.

notes: The three data products (NowCast/Forecast/API) and their behavior are STRONG (EPA/AirNow authoritative). The agent-capability mapping is reasoned SYNTHESIS grounding those products + SQ1/SQ3 findings — hence moderate. Verbatim per-category EPA cautionary action statements (e.g. exact 'reduce prolonged or heavy exertion' wording) not captured this cycle; the /all-activity-guides page can supply exact text if the deliverable needs it.
